metadata.article_title: Instrument negotiable till payment or satisfaction.

article.title: Instrument negotiable till payment or satisfaction.
article.content:
60Instrument negotiable till payment or satisfaction.

Section 60  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 16 of the Act
A negotiable instrument may be negotiated (except by the maker, drawee or acceptor after maturity) until payment or satisfaction thereof by the maker, drawee or acceptor at or after maturity, but not after such payment or satisfaction.
